## d93da02d5ee0

**Reproduced issue: advertised exact controls are ignored or rejected, and unknown keys
are accepted.**

Assigned generator SHA-256:
`a33c92cab99b2c8b67cca68b3e81796bdc6ed5d782eaafdc45224641bccdead6`.
At seed `0`, sample index `0`:

- `n_x=1` and `n_x=5` produce the same grid hash and both contain two detected X shapes;
- `palette_size=1,n_distinct_colors=1` and
  `palette_size=8,n_distinct_colors=8` produce the same grid hash;
- unknown `typo_axis=123` is accepted and produces the same grid.

All requested values above are documented as valid except the deliberately unknown key.
The compact executable reproducer and complete grids are
`checks/audit/d93da02d5ee0/reproduce_overrides.py` and
`checks/audit/d93da02d5ee0/override-reproducer.json`.

The official override stage also failed, reporting more than 5,043 displayed/suppressed
findings and warning that 33,060 multi-axis rejections were accepted under the legacy
policy without declared incompatibilities. Source-bound evidence is
`checks/audit/d93da02d5ee0/override/checks/d93da02d5ee0_after_override_results.json`.
The defect linter separately found missing `self_check`, four dead helpful textures,
negative texture/domain overlap, and no `RULE_HASH` pin; see
`checks/audit/d93da02d5ee0/defect-lint/checks/d93da02d5ee0_after_defect_lint.log`.

This is an audit finding only. No source under `generators/d93da02d5ee0/` was modified.
